hook.say: Turkey against the world, round two! Bigger or smaller? Five duels, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is bigger: Türkiye or Iraq?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Turkey or Iraq?
questions.fact: Türkiye is nearly 80% bigger than Iraq.
questions.sayAnswer: Turkey! It is nearly eighty percent bigger than Iraq.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Türkiye or Iran?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Turkey or Iran?
questions.fact: Iran is more than twice the size of Türkiye.
questions.sayAnswer: Iran! It is more than twice the size of Turkey.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Türkiye or Egypt?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Turkey or Egypt?
questions.fact: Egypt is about 28% bigger than Türkiye.
questions.sayAnswer: Egypt! It is about twenty-eight percent bigger than Turkey.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Türkiye or Zambia?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Turkey or Zambia?
questions.fact: Türkiye is about 4% bigger than Zambia.
questions.sayAnswer: Turkey! It is about four percent bigger than Zambia.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Türkiye or Venezuela?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Turkey or Venezuela?
questions.fact: Venezuela is about 16% bigger than Türkiye.
questions.sayAnswer: Venezuela! It is about sixteen percent bigger than Turkey.
